name: tiktok-uploader
description: TikTok uploader: shared TypeScript engine with a desktop app and a CLI

scripts.build:cli: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @tiktok-uploader/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tiktok-uploader/core && npm run typecheck -w @tiktok-uploader/cli && npm run typecheck -w @tiktok-uploader/desktop
